device_entry.name: AS7341多通道光谱传感器
device_entry.description: 这是一种基于AS7341的多通道可见光光谱传感器，可对多个波段的光强进行采样并输出光谱读数。它适用于实验室中的颜色分析、光源表征、样品透射或反射光测量，以及需要快速获取离散波段光学信息的教学与原型实验。
device_entry.description_en: This is a multi-channel visible-light spectral sensor based on the AS7341, designed to sample light intensity across multiple wavelength bands and report spectral readings. It is useful in laboratories for color analysis, light-source characterization, transmission or reflection measurements of samples, and teaching or prototyping tasks that need fast discrete-band optical data.
